def signed_int_label(n):
    """Render an integer as an explicitly signed textual label.

    Overview
    --------
    In tabulated reports and change summaries, positive quantities are
    conventionally displayed with an explicit plus sign so that gains and
    losses may be distinguished at a glance. This function performs that
    rendering for a single value. n is an int. Return str(n) but with a
    leading '+' when n is strictly positive (zero and negative values use
    plain str(n)).

    Returns
    -------
    str
        The label described above.

    Examples
    --------
    >>> signed_int_label(0)
    '0'
    >>> signed_int_label(3)
    '+3'
    """
